description_en: Triggers the specified IPC device to start recording and uploads the recording file to the cloud
description_zh: 调用该接口立即触发指定IPC设备开始录像，并上传录像文件至云端
name: TriggerRecord

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs. You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation to query all products under the current account.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The DeviceName of the IPC device. You can view the DeviceName on the Devices page in the IoT Platform console.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的设备页查看DeviceName。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The IotId of the IPC device. The IotId is the unique identifier that is issued by IoT Platform to the device. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html operation of IoT Platform to query the IotId.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. The IotId is the unique identifier of the device and corresponds to the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en:
The stream type. Valid values:
0 (default): main stream.
1: sub stream
parameters.help_zh:
码流类型：
0（默认）：主码流。
1：辅码流
parameters.name: stream_type

parameters.help_en:
The pre-recording duration. Valid values: 0 to 10. Unit: seconds.

The pre-recording duration is generated only when the device supports the pre-recording feature. Otherwise, the pre-recording duration is 0
parameters.help_zh:
预录时长，取值范围0~10，单位为秒。

设备具备预录功能时，才可生成预录时长，否则，预录时长为0
parameters.name: pre_record_duration

parameters.help_en:
The recording duration, including the pre-recording duration. Valid values: 10 to 7200. Unit: seconds.

The maximum length of a single recording file is 30 minutes. If the recording duration exceeds 30 minutes, the recording is automatically split into multiple recording files
parameters.help_zh:
录像时长，包括预录时长，取值范围10~7200，单位为秒。

单个录像文件长度最大为30分钟，当录像时长大于30分钟时，会自动切割成多个录像文件
parameters.name: record_duration

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If the instance has an ID, you must specify the ID. Otherwise, the call fails.</props>

<props="china">
If the public instance does not have an ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>

<props="intl">You do not need to specify this parameter.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>

<props="intl">无需传入此参数。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en:
The response code. Valid values:

200: Success.
Other values: Error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

Data.description_en: The ID of the recording file generated after the recording obtained by the IPC device is uploaded
Data.description_zh: IPC设备获取的录像上传后，生成的录像文件ID

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
